Transport - Hangar
Hugo: Eric Wang? I've heard that name somewhere.
Foglia: He's a member of the Tsentr Project. He used to be at the EOTI Institute and apparently helped design the Granzon.
Hugo: The Granzon...? Then he's connected to Shu Shirakawa. That's a big name.
Foglia: Word is our next mission is a request from him. Bet it's some rotten job.
Hugo: ...
Foglia: Besides, I've got a bad feeling. Especially since we're headed to the White Star.
Hugo: But we don't get to choose our operation area. We go where we're told.
Foglia: You're so obedient, Hugo. I'm sick of tailing the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom... and spying's not my thing.
Hugo: Our job right now is cleaning up after their battles and collecting data. Quit complaining.
Foglia: Can you blame me? How long are we gonna be errand boys for a bunch of scientists?
Hugo: Instead of griping, think about living up to the trust our commander showed by picking you for this mission.
Foglia: ...You're such a model student. You'll go far, I'm sure.
Hugo: ...
Transport - Cockpit
Albero: The target is the Horned Man...
Eric: Mm-hmm. The <Super Robot> they call the Zweibargain, or the Twice-Again, eh.
Eric: Going over the data you lot gave me, it seems that fellow's carrying that thing, eh.
Albero: What thing?
Eric: Hm? What was it again?
Albero: You don't mean a spatial transfer device...
Eric: Yes, yes. You're a sharp one, eh.
Albero: ...And you want it?
Eric: Would you go to the White Star and fetch it for me?
Eric: I won't ask for the whole Zweibargain... The wreckage will do, just the wreckage.
Albero: What for?
Eric: Mitar and I are thinking of building a weapon that could destroy the Granzon. Ho ho ho!
Albero: ...!
Eric: You see, if it really wanted to, the Granzon could wipe out the whole Federation Army in a single day.
Albero: In one day...? That's hard to believe.
Eric: Mm-hmm. Long ago I let something like that slip, and the people around me gave me a terrible thrashing for it.
Eric: But I helped design the Granzon myself, you know. It's not entirely a lie, eh.
Albero: ...
Eric: Anyway, if we don't do something about that machine soon, things could get very ugly indeed.
Albero: From what I've seen in the records, Shu Shirakawa hasn't taken any notable hostile action since the L5 Campaign.
Eric: That's only because his interests happen to line up with ours.
Eric: Once he has all the factors he's after, he'll bare his fangs for certain, like... chomp.
Albero: And what are those factors?
Eric: Hmmm... What were they again? I've gone and forgotten. Ho ho ho!
Albero: ...
Eric: In any case, with a transfer device, the Granzon will be easier to beat, eh.
Albero: Your comparison is hard to swallow, but that machine does outclass all others. ...Can it be destroyed?
Eric: Well, if you know the Granzon's secret, eh.
Albero: Its secret...? What is it?
Eric: Hm? Eh? What was it again? Slipped my mind completely. Ho ho ho!
Albero: (This man... is he doing this on purpose?)
Eric: Besides, Shu doesn't seem to mind the idea, eh.
Albero: ? What do you mean?
Eric: He's left me alone, knowing I know the Granzon's secret. Maybe he's actually waiting, eh.
Albero: I'm asking what you mean by...
Eric: Well then, I'm counting on you with that Twice-Again business. Ho ho ho!
Albero: ...

Mitar: The <White Star> has vanished?
Eric: Mm-hm.
Mitar: Did it explode?
Eric: According to the Cry Wolves' report, it seems to have teleported.

Eric: Who can say? Only God's nose, as they say.

Eric: Er, only God knows... is what I meant.
Mitar: ...
Mitar: (Did the <Inspectors> flee, White Star and all? Or else...)
Mitar: (If the Kurogane and the Hiryu Custom vanished along with it, so much the better.)
Mitar: (Because then the Tsentr Project's results will be needed by more than just Steinbeck's faction.)
Eric: My, my, what a shame. The White Star must have been a treasure trove.
Mitar: Did the Cry Wolves secure the Hornedman?
Eric: No. They recovered a similar unit, but it seems they dropped it in the confusion of their escape.
Mitar: Hmph... So Albero blundered.
Eric: I suppose it goes to show you can't take shortcuts. We'll just have to do it the slow way.
Mitar: And can you build a weapon capable of destroying the Granzon that way?
Eric: Well, now... maybe someone else will take care of that thing for us. Ho ho ho.
Mitar: (...And that's not a shortcut?)
